# TASK-071 — Feature flags

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Gate 7 — administration, governance and infrastructure (2026-09-27)

## Intent

Feature flags: a workspace Owner/Admin can switch every optional feature on or off from Administration. The server enforces the switch (routes, AI queueing, worker, sign-in options); the client hides the matching views, actions and tour steps.

## What it delivers

API, worker and component tests pass; Storybook axe clean; Playwright journey switches the board off in the running app (navigation, Alt+0 and the API follow) and back on.
